evidence.name: Screen field: Color of the bar
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Color of the bar" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Color of the bar
sections.description: Sets the color of the bar behind the pinned button (appears only when the bar is shown; defaults to white). Match it to your screen or theme background so the bar feels built-in, and make sure it contrasts with the button so the CTA stays the most eye-catching thing on screen. That contrast is what keeps the call-to-action obvious to paid-traffic visitors.
